collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child asks whether distant people count the exact day each person was born and celebrate it every year.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a child, asks whether distant people count the exact day each person was born and celebrate it every year.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children love the idea and want their own feast immediately.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder wonders whether so many feasts would leave any time for work.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar suggests that some distant people might not count years at all, and might live just as well.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder admits they have lost count of their own age and are happy about it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village holds a small celebration for anyone who wants one, and several people do.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Nobody can remember their exact birth day, and the idea is quietly abandoned.
